_comment: Envelope schema for a discovery 'signal recipe'. Validated at startup by recipes.py (hand-rolled, stdlib-only -- no jsonschema dep). additionalProperties:false is the GATE-SAFETY boundary: a recipe may ONLY declare discovery + routing config. It cannot add a key that reaches the trust gates (ICP filter, verbatim gate, verify, richness) -- those are inherited by every recipe and enforced in code. A recipe must carry exactly one body: 'surfaces' (object, base-map shape) OR 'features' (array, config-2026 shape).
